ev.q: an average of 2.4 million eye-related visits were made to emergency departments
43.7 visits per 10,000 persons were the result of medical conditions
37.6 visits per 10,000 persons were the result of injuries
The eye-related visit rate for a medical condition was highest among those aged ≤18 years
Children and persons aged ≥65 years were more likely to visit the ED for an eye-related medical condition than an eye injury.
Source: National Hospital Ambulatory Medical Care Survey.

methods_quotes.q: Per 10,000 population, based on 4-year annual average.
